title: Micropatterning of Cells on Gold Surfaces for Biophysical Applications
protocol: Prepare a solution of 1 mg/mL PEG-SH in ultrapure water.
Store the PEG-SH solution at 4°C.
Wash gold coated coverslips in ethanol in an ultrasonic bath for 2 min.
Dry gold coated coverslips in a stream of dry nitrogen.
Perform surface pre-treatment to clean gold coated coverslips in air plasma for 40 s.
Incubate the coverslips with 200 μL of PEG-SH solution at room temperature for 48 h in argon atmosphere.
Drip dry the remaining solution on coverslips after 48 hours.
Clean the coverslips in ethanol using an ultrasonic bath for 5 minutes.
Dry the coverslips with a stream of dry nitrogen.
Rinse the photomask in isopropanol, water, and ethanol.
Dry the photomask with a stream of dry nitrogen.
Clean the photomask in air plasma at 100 W for 40 seconds.
Place the cleaned photomask on a paper tissue with the chrome side facing upwards.
Pipette 5 μL of ultrapure water onto the mask as an adhesion layer.
Turn the cover glass so that the non-pegylated side is facing up and in contact with the water.
Turn the mask upside down.
Place the chromium side with coverslips facing down on a lifting platform.
Press the cover glass to the mask carefully using the back of a plastic pipette tip to remove air bubbles.
Adjust the distance between the mask and UV lamp to 0.5 cm using the lifting platform.
Irradiate the coverslips with UV light for 5 min at an energy dose density of 70 mW/cm2.
Prepare a sterile solution of 1 mg/mL fibronectin in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Mix the fibronectin solution with Cy3 as described in the Cy3 Amersham Mono-Reactive Dye Pack.
Protect the dye Cy3 from light with aluminum foil and switch off the light or darken the room.
Rinse pegylated coverslips in ethanol in the biosafety cabinet to get them sterile.
Dilute solution 3 to 10 μg/mL in PBS (solution 4).
Pipette 500 μL of solution 4 on top and incubate for 2 h.
Check the general health state of the 3T3 cell line with the microscope.
Aspirate the old medium.
Wash gently with 5 mL PBS and aspirate it.
Detach your cells with 0.5 mL 0.25% trypsin and store them for 3 min in an incubator at 5% CO2, 37°C.
Tap gently against the cell culture flask and look under the microscope to see if the cells have detached.
Stop the reaction with 4.5 mL medium and suspend well to obtain evenly distributed single cells.
Determine the cell count.
Seed the cells in 3 mL medium per coverslip and petri dish.
Keep the cells incubated for 8–10 h in an incubator at 5% CO2, 37°C.
Prepare a solution of 4% formaldehyde in PBS fresh for use.
Remove the medium and carefully wash cells with PBS, avoiding direct pipetting onto cover glass.
Incubate coverslips for 10 min with 2 ml 4% formaldehyde.
Wash coverslips three times with PBS.
Prepare a solution of 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS.
Pipette Triton X-100 slowly and carefully using reverse pipetting.
Vortex the mixture for a few minutes to ensure homogeneous mixing.
Incubate cover glasses with 2 mL of the 0.5% Triton X-100 solution for 10 min.
Wash the cover glasses three times with PBS.
Incubate the coverslips with 2 mL of 3% BSA in MilliQ water for at least 30 min.
Remove the BSA solution from the coverslips.
Pipette 2 mL of Alexa 568 phalloidin diluted in PBS (1:100) into a petri dish.
Incubate the coverslips with Alexa 568 phalloidin for 10 h at 4°C.
Remove the dye and wash the coverslips three times with PBS.
Store the slide with cells upwards in a petri dish containing PBS for imaging.
